summary: No findings. Trust boundary is CLI argv only: --lineup is looked up with Object.hasOwn against a three-key literal map, so prototype keys (toString, __proto__, constructor) and unknown names are rejected with a usage error before any play; the echoed Options/Replay suffix uses the normalised preset name, never raw argv. seatLineUp also guards size, user seat and preset with RangeError. No shell, file-path, or eval sinks are touched. Bots still receive only the PlayerView produced by the existing playerView() path in playHand, so no hidden cards reach them; decideStyle is a straight move of the advice-service dispatch. Action legality is unchanged (existing bot logic plus runner invariant checks). Randomness is the existing seeded botRandom(botDecisionSeed(code, view)) / seatGenerator per seat; no Math.random in src/bots or src/playtest. Bot names are plain generic first names (Ava..Ivy), original text with no third-party content (REQ-061). No new dependencies.
